def transform(grid):
    # Four 4x4 color panels are separated by the vertical 3 bars.
    # Overlay them by priority: 9, then 4, then 8, then 5.
    panels = [
        [[grid[r][c] for c in range(0, 4)] for r in range(4)],
        [[grid[r][c] for c in range(5, 9)] for r in range(4)],
        [[grid[r][c] for c in range(10, 14)] for r in range(4)],
        [[grid[r][c] for c in range(15, 19)] for r in range(4)],
    ]
    priority = (9, 4, 8, 5)
    out = []
    for r in range(4):
        row = []
        for c in range(4):
            vals = [p[r][c] for p in panels]
            row.append(next((color for color in priority if color in vals), 0))
        out.append(row)
    return out
